verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ שִׁ֣ירוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה חָדָ֑שׁ שִׁ֣יר תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ בִּקְהַ֥ל חֲסִידִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū yāh šî·rū Yah·weh ḥā·ḏāš šîr tə·hil·lā·ṯōw biq·hal ḥă·sî·ḏîm
verses.literal: Hallelujah . . . Sing to the LORD a new song His praise in the assembly of the godly

verses.original: יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל יִשְׂמַ֣ח בְּעֹשָׂ֑יו בְּנֵֽי־ צִ֝יּ֗וֹן יָגִ֥ילוּ בְמַלְכָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·rā·’êl yiś·maḥ bə·‘ō·śāw bə·nê- ṣî·yō·wn yā·ḡî·lū ḇə·mal·kām
verses.literal: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker let the children of Zion rejoice in their King

verses.original: יְהַֽלְל֣וּ שְׁמ֣וֹ בְמָח֑וֹל יְזַמְּרוּ־ לֽוֹ׃ בְּתֹ֥ף וְ֝כִנּ֗וֹר
verses.transliteration: yə·hal·lū šə·mōw ḇə·mā·ḥō·wl yə·zam·mə·rū- lōw bə·ṯōp̄ wə·ḵin·nō·wr
verses.literal: Let them praise His name with dancing and make music to Him with tambourine and harp

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֣ה רוֹצֶ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ יְפָאֵ֥ר עֲ֝נָוִ֗ים בִּישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh rō·w·ṣeh bə·‘am·mōw yə·p̄ā·’êr ‘ă·nā·wîm bî·šū·‘āh
verses.literal: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people He adorns the afflicted with salvation

verses.original: חֲסִידִ֣ים יַעְלְז֣וּ בְּכָב֑וֹד יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ עַל־ מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.literal: Let the saints exult in glory let them shout for joy upon their beds

verses.original: רוֹמְמ֣וֹת אֵ֭ל בִּגְרוֹנָ֑ם פִּֽיפִיּ֣וֹת וְחֶ֖רֶב בְּיָדָֽם׃
verses.literal: May the high praises of God be in their mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands

verses.original: לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת נְ֭קָמָה בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם תּֽ֝וֹכֵחֹ֗ת בַּל־ אֻמִּֽים׃
verses.literal: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples

verses.original: לֶאְסֹ֣ר מַלְכֵיהֶ֣ם בְּזִקִּ֑ים וְ֝נִכְבְּדֵיהֶ֗ם בְּכַבְלֵ֥י בַרְזֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: le’·sōr mal·ḵê·hem bə·ziq·qîm wə·niḵ·bə·ḏê·hem bə·ḵaḇ·lê ḇar·zel
verses.literal: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with shackles of iron

verses.original: לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת בָּהֶ֨ם׀ מִשְׁפָּ֬ט כָּת֗וּב ה֭וּא הָדָ֣ר לְכָל־ חֲסִידָ֗יו הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: la·‘ă·śō·wṯ bā·hem miš·pāṭ kā·ṯūḇ hū hā·ḏār lə·ḵāl ḥă·sî·ḏāw hal·lū- yāh
verses.literal: to execute - the judgment written [against them] This honor is for all His saints Hallelujah . . .
